mapper.sql: request_row.request_id, request_row.request_no, request_row.title, request_row.purpose, request_row.status, request_row.requested_by_user_cd, request_row.requested_by_user_id, request_row.requested_by_user_nm, request_row.requested_dept_cd, request_row.requested_dept_nm, TO_CHAR(request_row.submitted_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS submitted_at, TO_CHAR(request_row.decided_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS decided_at, request_row.decided_by_user_cd, request_row.decided_by_user_id, request_row.decided_by_user_nm, request_row.decision_comment, TO_CHAR(request_row.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created_at, TO_CHAR(request_row.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM docs_distribution_request_item item_count WHERE item_count.request_id = request_row.request_id)::integer AS item_count
mapper.select: INSERT INTO docs_distribution_request ( request_no, title, purpose, status, requested_by_user_cd, requested_by_user_id, requested_by_user_nm, requested_dept_cd, requested_dept_nm, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( 'DREQ-' || TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || LPAD(NEXTVAL('docs_distribution_request_no_seq')::varchar, 8, '0'), #{request.title}, #{request.purpose}, 'DRAFT', #{actor.userCd}, #{actor.userId}, #{actor.userNm}, #{actor.deptCd}, #{actor.deptNm}, #{actor.userCd}, #{actor.userCd} ) RETURNING request_id

WITH source_file AS (
SELECT 'SW'::varchar AS object_type, info.object_id, file_info.file_no::varchar AS file_no, info.sw_no AS material_no, info.sw_nm AS material_name, file_info.org_file_nm AS original_file_name, CASE WHEN BTRIM(COALESCE(file_info.file_size::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN file_info.file_size::bigint ELSE 0 END AS file_size FROM docs_sw info JOIN docs_sw_file file_info ON file_info.object_id = info.object_id WHERE info.object_id = #{objectId} AND file_info.file_no::varchar = #{fileNo} AND COALESCE(info.deleted_yn, 'N') = 'N'
SELECT 'SW_SUB'::varchar AS object_type, info.object_id, sub_file.file_no::varchar AS file_no, info.sw_no AS material_no, info.sw_nm AS material_name, sub_file.org_file_nm AS original_file_name, COALESCE(sub_file.file_size, 0)::bigint AS file_size FROM docs_sw info JOIN docs_sw_sub_file sub_file ON sub_file.parent_object_id = info.object_id WHERE info.object_id = #{objectId} AND sub_file.file_no::varchar = #{fileNo} AND COALESCE(info.deleted_yn, 'N') = 'N' AND COALESCE(sub_file.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y'
SELECT ''::varchar AS object_type, ''::varchar AS object_id, ''::varchar AS file_no, ''::varchar AS material_no, ''::varchar AS material_name, ''::varchar AS original_file_name, 0::bigint AS file_size WHERE FALSE
) SELECT source_file.*, effective_label.grade_cd, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS snapshot_at FROM source_file LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT label.grade_cd FROM docs_file_security_label label LEFT JOIN docs_security_grade grade_order ON grade_order.grade_cd = label.grade_cd WHERE label.object_id = source_file.object_id AND ( (label.object_type = source_file.object_type AND label.file_no IN (source_file.file_no, '*')) OR (source_file.object_type = 'SW_SUB' AND label.object_type = 'SW' AND label.file_no = '*') ) ORDER BY grade_order.grade_level DESC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN label.object_type = source_file.object_type AND label.file_no = source_file.file_no THEN 0 WHEN label.object_type = source_file.object_type AND label.file_no = '*' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END LIMIT 1 ) effective_label ON TRUE
SELECT FROM docs_distribution_request request_row WHERE request_row.request_id = #{value} FOR UPDATE OF request_row

SELECT item_id, request_id, line_no, object_type, object_id, file_no, material_no, material_name, original_file_name, file_size, grade_cd, TO_CHAR(snapshot_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS snapshot_at FROM docs_distribution_request_item WHERE request_id = #{value} ORDER BY line_no
mapper.update: UPDATE docs_distribution_request SET title = #{request.title}, purpose = #{request.purpose}, status = 'DRAFT', submitted_at = NULL, decided_at = NULL, decided_by_user_cd = NULL, decided_by_user_id = NULL, decided_by_user_nm = NULL, decision_comment = NULL, updated_by = #{actor.userCd}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE docs_distribution_request SET status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL', submitted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor.userCd}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE docs_distribution_request SET status = 'APPROVED', decided_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, decided_by_user_cd = #{actor.userCd}, decided_by_user_id = #{actor.userId}, decided_by_user_nm = #{actor.userNm}, decision_comment = NULLIF(#{comment}, ''), updated_by = #{actor.userCd}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE docs_distribution_request SET status = 'REJECTED', decided_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, decided_by_user_cd = #{actor.userCd}, decided_by_user_id = #{actor.userId}, decided_by_user_nm = #{actor.userNm}, decision_comment = #{comment}, updated_by = #{actor.userCd}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE docs_distribution_request SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_by = #{actor.userCd}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO docs_distribution_request_event ( request_id, from_status, to_status, event_type, actor_user_cd, actor_user_id, actor_user_nm, event_comment ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{eventType}, #{actor.userCd}, #{actor.userId}, #{actor.userNm}, NULLIF(#{comment}, '') )

INSERT INTO docs_distribution_outbox ( request_id, aggregate_id, event_type, status, payload_json ) SELECT request_row.request_id, request_row.request_no, 'DISTRIBUTION_APPROVED', 'HOLD', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'schemaVersion', 1, 'requestId', request_row.request_id, 'requestNo', request_row.request_no, 'status', request_row.status, 'title', request_row.title, 'purpose', request_row.purpose, 'requestedBy', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'userCd', request_row.requested_by_user_cd, 'userId', request_row.requested_by_user_id, 'userName', request_row.requested_by_user_nm, 'deptCd', request_row.requested_dept_cd, 'deptName', request_row.requested_dept_nm ), 'approvedBy', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'userCd', request_row.decided_by_user_cd, 'userId', request_row.decided_by_user_id, 'userName', request_row.decided_by_user_nm ), 'approvedAt', TO_JSONB(request_row.decided_at), 'items', COALESCE( JSONB_AGG( JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'lineNo', item.line_no, 'objectType', item.object_type, 'objectId', item.object_id, 'fileNo', item.file_no, 'materialNo', item.material_no, 'materialName', item.material_name, 'originalFileName', item.original_file_name, 'fileSize', item.file_size, 'gradeCd', item.grade_cd, 'snapshotAt', item.snapshot_at ) ORDER BY item.line_no ) FILTER (WHERE item.item_id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb ) ) FROM docs_distribution_request request_row LEFT JOIN docs_distribution_request_item item ON item.request_id = request_row.request_id WHERE request_row.request_id = #{value} AND request_row.status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY request_row.request_id ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM docs_distribution_outbox WHERE request_id = #{value}
